files.intent: Register Sprint M9 / SG-GEOM-AUTH-001: the Smart Guitar geometry authority package, its dispositions, and the contradictions already on main.

title: docs(sprints): register SG-GEOM-AUTH-001 as a temporary, non-authoritative Smart Guitar observation record pending the CAD model

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The current Smart Guitar design rulings exist only in session notes. docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md Rule 6 forbids chat-only notes as the system of record, which is how the 4.5 deg op20_status survived three supersessions unnoticed. No other SPRINTS entry carries body height, the 12th-fret attachment, the neck-angle band or the neck-pocket dispositions.
diff_articulation.what_changed: Appends one DATA INTEGRITY sprint section before ## COMPLETED. It records the owner's 2026-09-20 geometry package with a per-quantity disposition table (521.8 current working authority / 528.1 superseded / 438.15 reference only), the design-ruling-to-CAM authority chain, the provisional body-height-to-body_length_mm equivalence, the quantities derived from 528.1 that must be recomputed before reuse, and the contradictions re-read on main. No record file, schema or calculator is amended. Review pass 2026-09-20. Four findings from the risk assessment are incorporated: (1) the 12th-fret ruling is recorded as contradicting the join-fret fields themselves, naming the three Smart Guitar fields that carry one (v1 neck.neck_length.body_join_fret 'TBD 19 or 20', setup neck_relief.body_join_fret 19, sweep neck_joint_fret 19) and explicitly excluding explorer_baseline.neck_joint_fret 22 as a fact about the Explorer; (2) the scale staleness is widened from the solver block to smart_guitar_geometry.scale_mm 628.65, a governing field, against v1's revised 647.7, with parent_models scale values excluded for the same reason; (3) 26.59 is relabelled from an asserted pocket requirement to what the record actually holds -- a neck-and-fretboard stack at the 12th fret, sourced from the Explorer, with no derivation connecting it to a pocket depth -- and the 17.86 floor figure is marked as inheriting that ungoverned premise; (4) the 47.0 claim is scoped to the grep that supports it. Three further defects found while verifying: the record states the owner neck-angle band as 1.5-2.5 deg three times at setup_spec:43 while this entry states 1.5-2.0, which is now flagged unreconciled rather than silently resolved; the solver sweep was cited from its 10-13mm rows only, and the full nine-row table gates GREEN from 1.13 to 3.31 deg so it discriminates nothing and is now marked not usable as manufacturing evidence; and the record's own note that the heel stack is unmeasured is quoted, since it independently refutes using a 12th-fret figure as the shoulder requirement. Pass 3, owner-directed 2026-09-20. The entry no longer presents anything as a ruling to defend. Status line reads TEMPORARY OBSERVATION RECORD, PENDING OWNER DECISION, IT ESTABLISHES NO AUTHORITY. A scope blockquote states that the design is under active revision, that the parameters will be finalized by the owner once CAD has produced an acceptable model, that every Part A figure is provisional and may change including those that look settled, and that the record deliberately does NOT ask the owner to adjudicate anything yet because resolving a value before CAD would fix a number the model is about to determine. The former 'Geometry package -- owner ruling' table becomes PART A -- WORKING VALUES (IN REVISION . NOT AUTHORITY), and 'CURRENT WORKING AUTHORITY' becomes 'WORKING VALUE'. The contradictions section becomes PART B -- CONTRADICTION LOG (EVIDENCE ONLY) with a banner stating it records what the repository says and nothing about what is correct, and that no bullet may be read as a correction or a value to build from. PART C -- WHAT MUST HAPPEN, AND WHO SIGNS carries the close trigger, now rewritten so every item resolves against the accepted CAD model rather than by choosing between recorded values on paper, plus a new item 8 requiring the accepted model and the signoff, plus an Owner signoff block with four checkboxes. The authority chain diagram is redrawn to show two open gates -- CAD MODEL ACCEPTED BY OWNER and OWNER SIGNOFF -- instead of one. The neck-angle band conflict is downgraded from a demand for an owner call to a logged conflict that CAD settles. The op20_status safety stop is strengthened to say the correct angle is not yet known by anyone, including this entry, and that the stop lifts when the model is accepted and Part C is signed, not when this PR merges. Heading levels corrected to #### / ##### so the parts nest inside the sprint instead of becoming siblings of ## COMPLETED.

intent: Give the geometry reconciliation a system-of-record starting point that preserves the authority distinctions exactly, without prematurely claiming CAD verification. Review pass 2026-09-20 addresses the PR #388 risk assessment. The entry is relabelled an OBSERVATION RECORD whose arithmetic is an observation about the records and never derived geometry authority; the op20_status safety stop is promoted to a blockquote at the top stating that nothing has been corrected and OP20 is not safe to run at any angle; the cross-repo source is given as a full SHA with a public permalink and both file paths; and the cited record files are pinned by blob id, since line numbers drift. Owner instruction 2026-09-20: the Smart Guitar design is under active revision and the parameters will be finalized by the owner once the CAD operation has produced an acceptable model. The entry is restructured to say that explicitly. It is labelled a TEMPORARY OBSERVATION RECORD PENDING OWNER DECISION that ESTABLISHES NO AUTHORITY; it is split into three visually separated parts -- Part A working values (in revision, not authority), Part B contradiction log (evidence only, records nothing about what is correct), Part C what must happen and who signs; and it carries an owner signoff block that must be filled in before any part of it is operational.

behavior_change: None. SPRINTS.md and this manifest only. No instrument record, code, configuration, workflow or test is touched, and op20_status is NOT amended in either spec.
